ྈbla ma'i thugs sgrub rig 'dzin bde 'dus las:sde lnga lcam dral gyi mchod 'phrin bsam don lhun grub bzhugs:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub rig 'dzin bde 'dus las: sde lnga lcam dral gyi mchod 'phrin bsam don lhun grub bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sde lnga'i mchod thabs la: rin po che'i snod du dkar gsum mngar gsum dang rin po che brdar ba'i phye mar: dbus su dpal mgon zur gsum: g.yas su ma mo'i gtor ma zur gsum: g.yon du gza' gtor zur gsum g.yas gcus: mdun du dam can zur gsum ra mgos mtshan pa: rgyab tu rgyal por gsang phyi bcas mtheb kyu bzhi gsum gyis bskor bar rgyan spros mdzes par byas pa bsham: rang dpal chen po'i nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐: rnam kun mchog ldan mkha' klong nas: gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang: rtsal mdangs rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje sgyu 'phrul rtsa gsum lha: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas ni: gnas mchog 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs: dad pa rab kyis phyag 'tshal lo: bde mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes: bkod pa lus kyi gzhal yas 'dir: rtsa rlung nyams rtogs ye shes sbor: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ghu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni ar+ghaṃ nas: shab+da pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: 'og min gtum drag tshal chen nas: thugs rje drag por rol pa'i lha: dpal mgon ma ning nag po che: mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i sku: zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs spyan gsum gzigs: thod skam rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rdzogs: sbrul nag ral pa sa la bsnyil: phyag g.yas ru dar nag po dang: g.yon pa snying zhags dgra la 'debs: dar nag ber dang chas kun rdzogs: tsan dan beng chen sked la gzer: mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal can: pad nyi ru tra'i steng du 'gyings: 'khor du mgon po sde lngas bskor: 'dir gshegs dam tshig rten la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa bzhes: byang chub sgrub pa'i stongs grogs mdzod: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen sgrubs: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sarba pañca rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā pū dza la khā hi:

hūm̐: dbus phyogs me ri 'bar ba nas: e ka tsā ṭi khros ma yum: srog sgrub ma dang re ti ma: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan par srungs: tshe 'di'i bya bar yid pham nas: phyi ma'i don sgrub rnal 'byor la: sgrub la bar gcod gdon bgegs rnams: khyed kyis ming tsam med par bzhes: ma ma trag rak+sha pañca rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: hūm̐: bar snang yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gza' bdud nag po dug gdong can: gza' brgyad gdong bzhi dregs pa'i tshogs: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan pa gnyan bsrung dam nyams sgrol: zab chos bka' gsang gnyan po 'di: khyed la gtad do phrin las mdzod: a rā hu la pañca rak+ta bha liṃ ta khā hī: hūm̐: ma la ya dang 'u yug gling: dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang nas: skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa rtsal: dge bsnyen nyer gcig 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bsam don ma lus sgrub par mdzod: mchog gsang 'od gsal rdzogs pa che'i: ring lugs smad nas theg dman bstod: zab mo'i 'ja' lus shing rta'i srol: snub byed dgra bo rdul du rlogs: tri badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya pañca rak+ta bha liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: tshangs pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas: pe har yum mchog shān+ting ma: rol pa rkya bdun ru 'dren bzhi: 'khor tshogs dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod: ma hā rā dza pañca rak+ta ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: rdo rje'i chos srung khyed rnams ni: bdag cag yon bdag 'khor bcas kyis: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen yin pas: nad gdon bar gcod kun zhi zhing: tshe bsod dpal dang nyams rtogs rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus: gnod byed dgra bgegs chams la phob: snying thig 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yi: bsam don ma lus khyed kyis sgrubs:

mi nor zas gsum khyed la gnyer: srung skyob mdzod la mthu ma chung: zab gsang mi nub phyogs bcur spel: rgyal khams bde zhing dus dbang gi: mi mthun rkyen ngan kun zhi nas: rtag tu bde zhing skyid pa yi: phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: rig 'dzin srung ma khyod rnams ni: ma 'ongs brgyud 'dzin srung mar bzhugs: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: mthu dpung stongs grogs dpal skyed cig: zab gsang gnyan rgya'i rgya rtags bcas: mi nub rdo rje'i brag la sbos: dus la bab tshe zab gter rnams: bu la sprod pa'i grogs mdzod cig: sa ma ya: tsit+ta rgya: rgya: 1$0000280 mchims phu gur dkar phug nas me stag zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad la spyan drangs pa'o// //
